title: Average: members leaving a group
question: A reading club has 6 members. They read an average of 14 books each. When 2 members left the club, the average for the remaining 4 members became 12 books. What was the average number of books read by the 2 members who left?

timeline.say: A reading club has 6 members. They read an average of 14 books each. When 2 members left the club, the average for the remaining 4 members became 12 books. What was the average number of books read by the 2 members who left?
The 6 members read an average of 14 books each.
After 2 left, the other 4 members averaged 12 books.
Pause and think. How many books did all 6 members read?
The 4 who stayed read 4 times 12, which is 48 books.
So the 2 who left read 84 minus 48, which is 36 books.
Their average is 36 divided by 2, which is 18 books.
Let's check: 48 books, plus 18 each for 2 members, make 84. It works!

timeline.text: The 2 members who left read an average of 18 books.
timeline.say: So, the 2 members who left read an average of 18 books. Well done!
